name: Memory Recall Gate
description: Hippocampus recall: search and inject relevant memory context before every agent turn. The agent always starts with relevant history — it does not decide whether to look.

then.prompt:
Before responding to the user, do the following first:
1. Extract 3-5 key terms from the user's message.
2. Run: agent-memory search --query "<key terms>" --top-k 8
3. Run: agent-memory recall --task "<user message>" --budget 800 --format raw --include-observations
4. If results are found, use them as primary context before answering.
5. If no results are found, proceed with general knowledge and note the gap.
Do not skip this step even for simple questions.
